words: Closing D-gnev on Nick's own reviews after the method change to authored plume guides: 2026-10-21 'The dark hair that you have there and the style you have for the dark hair looks great' (white hair then rebuilt as the same hair in a different color), 2026-10-21 'much better' (odd chunk at the tip removed), 2026-10-24 'looks good' (check 4, plume follows the tail bones in flight). The sheet's pointed-tuft read is accepted as met by those approvals; any new plume request opens a new defect.
